title: 2016 AMC 10A Problem 4
statement: The remainder function can be defined for all real numbers \(x\) and \(y\) with \(y \neq 0\) by \[\operatorname{rem}(x,y)=x-y\left\lfloor\frac{x}{y}\right\rfloor,\] where \(\left \lfloor \frac{x}{y} \right \rfloor\) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to \(\frac{x}{y}.\) What is the value of \(\text{rem} \left(\frac{3}{8}, -\frac{2}{5} \right)?\)

solutions.text: Using the formula, we get \[ \begin{aligned} \text{rem} \left(\dfrac{3}{8}, -\dfrac{2}{5}\right) &= \dfrac{3}{8} \\ &{}+ \dfrac{2}{5} \left \lfloor \dfrac{\frac{3}{8}}{-\frac{2}{5}}\right \rfloor \\ &= \dfrac{3}{8} \\ &{}+ \dfrac{2}{5} \left \lfloor -\dfrac{15}{16} \right \rfloor \\ &= \dfrac{3}{8} + \dfrac{2}{5} \cdot -1 \\ &= \dfrac{3}{8} - \dfrac{2}{5} \\ &= - \dfrac{1}{40} \end{aligned} \] Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Compute \(\frac{x}{y}\) before applying the floor function
